There is access to the necessary tools and resources for Go development.

open_questions.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?

risks.description: Potential loss of functionality during translation.
risks.mitigation: Implement thorough testing and validation processes.

risks.description: Differences in concurrency models between Kotlin and Go.
risks.mitigation: Use Go's concurrency primitives effectively and test thoroughly.
Conduct security audits and use static analysis tools.

out_of_scope: UI/UX redesigns are not part of this migration.
New feature development beyond existing functionality.

relationships: LegacyInput contract must map deterministically to ModernizedOutput contract

standards_guidance.name: Android Architecture: MVVM + Unidirectional State Flow
engineering_actions: Keep UI state in a ViewModel exposed as StateFlow or Compose State.
Treat ViewModel as the single source of truth for screen-level state.
Emit one-shot side effects via a Channel / SharedFlow, not LiveData.

standards_guidance.name: Jetpack Compose-First UI
engineering_actions: New screens must be Composable functions; legacy XML layouts are interop bridges only.
Preview every screen with `@Preview` variants for light / dark / RTL.
Use Material 3 components unless an explicit design-system override exists.

standards_guidance.name: Offline-First Data Policy
engineering_actions: Reads must resolve from local cache first; network refresh is async.
Mutations enqueue to WorkManager or an equivalent persistent queue.
Conflict resolution is explicit (last-writer-wins or merge), never silent.

standards_guidance.name: Mobile Security Baseline
engineering_actions: Secrets at rest go through Android Keystore, never SharedPreferences.
Network calls to private APIs must use certificate pinning.
Release builds must enable R8 / ProGuard with keep rules for reflection points.

non_negotiables: All user-visible strings must be in string resources for localization.
No network calls on the main thread — use coroutines with Dispatchers.IO.
Every screen has at least one Compose preview and one instrumented test.
Release builds must pass lint with `-Werror` for critical severity rules.

must.title: Security Compliance
must.description: Ensure the Go codebase complies with security standards.
must.metric: Pass all security audits with no critical vulnerabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Security audits confirm no critical vulnerabilities.
Static analysis tools report zero high-severity issues.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: Ensure the Go implementation is reliable and available.
acceptance_criteria: Incident response times are within acceptable limits.
System logs show no critical errors during operation.

should.title: Performance Optimization
should.description: Ensure the Go implementation performs efficiently under load.
should.metric: Response time under 200ms for 95% of requests.
acceptance_criteria: No significant performance degradation from Kotlin to Go.
Load testing confirms system stability under expected load.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99.

should.title: Scalability
should.description: Ensure the system can scale to meet increased demand.
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests confirm system can handle increased load.
No bottlenecks identified during stress testing.
System performance metrics remain within acceptable range.
should.verification: Scalability testing with simulated user load.

should.title: Usability
should.description: Ensure the Go implementation is user-friendly and accessible.
should.metric: Usability score of 80% or higher in user testing.
acceptance_criteria: User testing confirms ease of use.
Accessibility tests confirm compliance with standards.
User feedback is positive regarding the new implementation.
